svg.title: A thoughtful message for Valentine’s Day

text.tspan: Everyday English - B2 - 2026/02/11 - Essay - 01
A handmade greeting creates a personal message.
Pexels · 6765938
A thoughtful message for Valentine’s Day
A good way to send a thoughtful greeting combines practical structure with an awareness of other people. Neither a rigid plan nor complete
improvisation is sufficient on its own; both need to be judged in context.
The practical case is straightforward: a specific message expresses care more clearly than a grand phrase. Consider how we thank a friend
for a particular act of kindness. The benefit is not merely efficiency. A modest arrangement prevents avoidable confusion, leaving attention
available for the activity itself rather than for problems that could have been anticipated.
Consideration adds a second, equally important dimension: respecting the recipient makes a greeting considerate. In this situation, we avoid
assuming that everyone wants a romantic message. A decision can be convenient for one person while creating difficulty for another, so its
value depends partly on whose needs it recognises.
The most useful approach therefore brings structure and consideration together. Preparation establishes a workable starting point; attention to
other people keeps it responsive. Success should be assessed by how well the arrangement serves the experience, rather than by how
closely events follow the original plan.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the conclusion. Each body
paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the argument rather than introduce a new proposal.
Write guidance for someone who wants to send a thoughtful greeting for the first time. Explain two useful choices and why they matter. Use
four short paragraphs: introduction, two developed points, and conclusion. (Model: One possible outline: introduce the situation; discuss a
specific message expresses care more clearly than a grand phrase with an example; discuss respecting the recipient makes a greeting
considerate with a different example; conclude by connecting the two points.)
